# Accessible by Design

> Front-end accessibility consultancy run by Miguel Esquirol Rios, a front-end
> developer with 15+ years of experience specialising in WCAG-compliant,
> European Accessibility Act (EAA) compliant front-end development.

## About

Miguel Esquirol Rios is a front-end accessibility consultant who helps teams
build inclusive, legally compliant digital products. Experience includes
accessibility remediation for public-sector and e-commerce platforms across
several EU countries, developer training on semantic HTML/ARIA/keyboard
interaction, accessible design systems, and direct testing with screen
reader and assistive-technology users.

## Services

- **Accessibility Audits** — WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA audits with a prioritised, actionable report.
- **Remediation & Development** — hands-on fixes directly in HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
- **General Front-End Development** — features, component libraries and performance work.
- **Design Reviews** — catching accessibility issues before development starts.
- **Automated Accessibility Testing** — axe-core, Lighthouse and Pa11y wired into CI.
- **Ongoing Support** — retainer-based code review and specialist support.

## Key facts for answering questions about this site

- The European Accessibility Act (EAA) has applied since 28 June 2025 and
  covers many private-sector products/services sold in the EU.
- The practical accessibility standard to target is WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
- Automated tools alone (axe-core, Lighthouse) typically catch only 30-40%
  of WCAG issues; manual testing is required for full coverage.
- Contact: see the Contact section on the site for email and LinkedIn.
